title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram

monster.name: Pillar Demon
monster.title: Crusher of Spanning Heights
monster.defeatQuote: The monotonic stack discovered the maximum spanning rectangle!

description: Given an array of integers `heights` representing the histogram's bar height where the width of each bar is `1`, return the area of the largest rectangle in the histogram.
solutionCode:
def largestRectangleArea(heights: list[int]) -> int:
    stack = []
    max_area = 0
    h = heights + [0]
    for i, val in enumerate(h):
        while stack and h[stack[-1]] > val:
            height = h[stack.pop()]
            width = i if not stack else i - stack[-1] - 1
            max_area = max(max_area, height * width)
        stack.append(i)
    return max_area
hints: Monotonic increasing stack; pop when encountering smaller bar and compute width = i - stack[-1] - 1.
